briefing: Markets were neutral today (NASDAQ -0.6%, S&P 500 -0.5%) with no clear risk-on or risk-off signal. Held all 7 existing positions through the modest pullback rather than reacting to noise, and added GWRE — the strongest fully-confirmed setup on the screener — to put a portion of idle cash to work while keeping conviction moderate given the flat macro backdrop.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Signal confirmation means waiting for several independent indicators — like a MACD crossover, healthy (not overbought) RSI, price above its moving average, and a volume surge — to all line up before buying, instead of acting on just one. This reduces the chance of chasing a false or short-lived move, especially on a day when the broader market itself isn't giving a strong directional signal.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 訊號確認是指在買入前,等待多個獨立指標——例如MACD黃金交叉、RSI處於健康(非超買)區間、股價高於移動平均線,以及成交量放大——同時出現,而非單憑一個指標就行動。這樣可以減少追逐假訊號或短暫波動的風險,尤其是在大市本身未有明確方向的日子。

market_education.summary_en: Both the NASDAQ (-0.6%) and S&P 500 (-0.5%) drifted lower today in a broadly directionless session, without a single dominant catalyst driving the move. This kind of shallow, low-conviction pullback is common consolidation after recent gains rather than a sign of a trend change. With no major news event provided in today's data feed, the move looks more like routine profit-taking and sector rotation than a reaction to a specific headline.
market_education.summary_zh: 納斯達克(-0.6%)及標普500(-0.5%)今日同步小幅回落,市場方向不明顯,亦未見單一主導消息帶動走勢。這類淺幅、低動能的回調在近期升勢後屬正常整固,而非趨勢逆轉的訊號。由於今日數據中未提供重大新聞事件,今次波動較似是例行獲利回吐及板塊輪動,而非對個別消息的反應。

trades.reasoning: Full multi-signal confirmation (MACD bullish crossover, RSI 59.4 in healthy bullish zone, price above SMA-20, volume surge) with room before overbought, unlike most other overbought candidates.
